title: The market decides what is searched for
blurb: The vocabulary resolver existed and nothing read it — an analysis still searched for what a reader typed, so the market’s name was a fact that changed nothing. Now it is what every company query is built from, and the substitution is shown on the report, including on the partial ones a reader watches for ninety seconds. A second round of searches goes out only when the words actually changed, and the coverage note counts both rounds so an outage in the first cannot hide behind the second.
